plan.objective_interpretation: Generate labeled PathMNIST images for augmentation and compare real-plus-synthetic classifiers against real-only training and class-matched real resampling. This task includes augmentation; the modest observed imbalance does not itself establish a need for balancing. Use validation evidence to select, revise or stop before a frozen final test.
evidence: The inspected publisher training split contains 89,996 uint8 RGB images of shape 28x28x3, with pixel range 0..255; both dimensions are divisible by four and below 64.
No missing or infinite values were reported. label_0 is complete and categorical with nine observed classes; majority-to-minority frequency ratio is approximately 1.634.
Input is medmnist_npz and splits were not combined; preserve official training, validation and test partitions.
MPS is available on an arm64 system with 16 GiB physical memory; approximately 4.65 GiB available memory is only an inspection snapshot, not a reserved allocation.
The total training ceiling is 30 minutes, with at most 100 epochs and 5,000 generated samples.

models.name: image_vae
models.reason: A conditional encoder-decoder provides a comparatively stable baseline for labeled augmentation under a short budget. Its Gaussian observation model may smooth histology texture, so utility must be measured rather than inferred from ELBO.
models.hyperparameter_rationale: Use all image pixels, scaled by 255, with complete label_0 one-hot conditioning in encoder and decoder. A 32-dimensional latent and 128-unit projection provide moderate capacity for small RGB patches; batch size 64 limits activation memory while supporting efficient updates. Adam uses betas (0.9,0.999), float32 and gradient clipping at 10. The 0.001 learning rate is an exploratory starting point. Twenty epochs and patience four bound training and allow several validation observations before stopping; 15 minutes is a hard ceiling, not a runtime estimate. Select the lowest complete fixed-seed Monte Carlo validation loss under the fixed standard-deviation 0.1 Gaussian, beta=1 ELBO. Generate 2,500 labeled Gaussian decoder draws from standard-normal latents, clip to [0,1] and use the trainer image output contract; retain decoder means separately without treating them as equivalent samples.

models.name: image_gan
models.reason: A conditional GAN offers a complementary implicit image model that may capture sharper texture, while carrying greater instability and mode-collapse risk. Its independent validation selection and downstream comparison justify a second exploratory candidate rather than assuming it outperforms the VAE.
models.hyperparameter_rationale: Scale uint8 pixels to [-1,1] and condition generator and discriminator on label_0 under trainer contract 1.0. A 64-dimensional latent provides flexible generation noise and hidden width 128 keeps capacity moderate; batch size 64 shares the memory-conscious setting of the VAE. Separate Adam optimizers use learning rate 0.0002 and required betas (0.5,0.999), float32 and gradient clipping at 10. Use the specified single discriminator update followed by non-saturating generator update. Twenty epochs, patience four and a 15-minute ceiling bound exploration without promising convergence. Select checkpoints by the required aggregate/per-class pooled-feature validation Wasserstein score using fixed up-to-512 training/validation subsets, a training-fitted scaler and fixed validation-label-matched latent draws. This score is neither FID nor ELBO. Generate 2,500 samples by rescaling and rounding tanh outputs to uint8, without extra observation noise.

excluded_models.name: count_vae
excluded_models.reason: Negative-binomial raw 10x count modeling is incompatible with RGB image pixels. Integer pixels do not establish gene-count semantics.

excluded_models.reason: Implemented only for unconditional continuous log-dequantized expression generation on a small selected gene panel; incompatible with conditional image augmentation.

evaluation.success_criteria: Apply evaluation contract 2.0. Validate finite outputs, exact expected image shapes, uint8 range and label alignment first; invalid output means do_not_use. For distribution_fidelity, use training-fitted standardized 4x4 pooled pixel/channel-variation features and mean marginal Wasserstein discrepancy overall and per class. Compare against equal-sized training-resampling and held-out-real references over ten fixed-seed draws, reporting medians and reference ranges rather than confidence intervals. Apply only the specified heuristic discrepancy screen: synthetic discrepancy <=1.1 times median real-reference discrepancy with absolute tolerance 1e-8. For diversity, compare median pairwise distances in those standardized features against equal-sized held-out samples using the specified 0.9..1.1 ratio screen. For nearest_neighbor_overlap, use a fixed training subset and its leave-one-out first-percentile distance threshold; report synthetic and held-out near rates and exact duplicate rates without privacy claims. Supplement these metrics with the contracted joint empirical energy distances for local-gradient statistics and training-only pixel PCA of up to 32 components, reference draws and conditional bootstrap intervals without additional cutoffs. Review fixed-seed per-class real/generated visual packets with source indices and explicit review status; these are not validated histology scores. Evaluate each model's augmentation separately using the fixed C=1 logistic classifier on training-fitted pooled-image features: real-only, real-plus-synthetic and class-matched real-resampling augmentation controls, matching the synthetic arm's added labels and sample counts. Report macro-F1 and per-class recall with paired class-stratified bootstrap comparisons. Use validation mode for selection and controlled revision or stopping; adversarial loss, ELBO and GAN checkpoint scores do not establish augmentation benefit. Freeze the chosen configuration and comparisons before final mode evaluates the official test once. Only a converged frozen comparison with positive paired intervals against both real-only and resampling supports task-scoped limited_use; a negative interval supports task-scoped do_not_use, and otherwise evidence remains insufficient_evidence. Quality screens alone never establish usability. The legacy utility_gate is descriptive, not the decision gate. Any revision must use remaining allocated time; if none remains, stop and propose a separately budgeted follow-up rather than exceed the ceiling.

plan.downstream_use: Synthetic images are provisional research augmentation candidates. Any support applies only to the measured pooled-feature logistic classification task and evaluated setting; appearance and classifier performance do not establish clinical validity.
limitations: This is a proposal; no training, evaluation or feasibility benchmark has run.
The two model allocations sum to the hard 30-minute ceiling. No executor pilot cap is assumed enabled; that requires an explicit execution flag.
Time-limited or unconverged runs and validation-only comparisons remain insufficient_evidence even if heuristic quality screens pass.

Each candidate generates 2,500 images, totaling 5,000. Conditional generation cycles approximately evenly across the nine observed training classes; it does not automatically equalize final real-plus-synthetic class totals.
The VAE may smooth texture and the GAN may collapse or train unstably; small pooled-feature discrepancies can miss clinically relevant structure.
Fit learned preprocessing, feature scalers and PCA only on official training data; use official validation for selection and reserve official test for the frozen final evaluation.

Classifier controls, visual review and supplementary evaluation require resources beyond the stated model-training allocations; their completion and convergence must be reported before any downstream recommendation.
Training overlap diagnostics provide no privacy guarantee, and neither model quality nor augmentation utility implies clinical validity.
